youtube.title: When Do Your Fingerprints Form?
youtube.caption:
When do your fingerprints form? Before you are born.

Ridges do not appear all at once. They start at a few places on the fingertip and spread outward in waves. Think of ripples spreading on sand. Where the waves meet shapes the type of pattern. So a fingerprint is a pattern of waves, set before birth. Yours is one of endless variations.

Series: Season 2: What your skin does, part 6 of 6. Next: more skin questions

Sources
1. Fingerprint ridge formation is established prenatally. — NIH: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36764291/

Narration: synthetic voice (AI). Illustrations: AI-generated and 3-D animation made in code, no stock footage. Every number's source is listed in this description.

Education, not medical advice. See a dermatologist about your own skin.
